historical_evaluation_policy: Never load reference rows, score, tune, or merge this already-observed cohort

protocol.configuration_outcomes_reused_across_fol: Allowed because configurations fit nothing across molecules
protocol.fold_bootstrap: Descriptive family bootstrap within fixed outer folds, conditional on the selected fold policies. Does not reselect configurations, account for overlapping training sets, or establish a joint 95% confidence guarantee. This is development cross-validation, not a fresh external holdout.
protocol.matching: Original fixed/window/full rules at >=max(95%, selected sequential training success)
protocol.selection: Training-only >=95% success, minimum calls, minimum p95 regret, maximum success, config ID
